description: This PHP source file defines the MyInfoAPI class, which is an API endpoint for retrieving information about the currently logged-in employee in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for fetching employee details with support for different models (default, detailed, summary) and uses traits and models specific to the HRM system.

classes.name: MyInfoAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for fetching the current employee's information, supporting different data models.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve the current employee's details based on the specified model parameter.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request, especially validating the 'model' query parameter.
